fetched_title: More Rejective, Not More Discriminative: The Unit of Verification in Pre-Execution LLM Oversight
summary: Introduces a twin-prefix framework that pairs an injected-error prefix with a clean twin and judges each pair at five nested review lengths, to isolate the unit of verification in pre-execution LLM monitors. The title states the finding that the unit changes rejectiveness more than discrimination; it concerns agent actions, not choice among candidate pools.
